title: CUTracer Kernel Metadata Record
description: Schema for kernel_metadata - per-launch metadata written as the first line in NDJSON trace files

kernel_checksum.description: FNV-1a hash hex string identifying the kernel

func_addr.description: Kernel function address in hex format

nregs.description: Number of registers used by the kernel (CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS)

shmem_static.description: Static shared memory size in bytes (CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES)

cubin_sha256.description: SHA256 of the actual dumped cubin bytes, including embedded PTX/debug information.

oneOf.description: Instrumentation plan capture; the plan_applied record that follows describes what was instrumented.

cubin_path.description: Bare filename of the dumped cubin, relative to the directory containing the trace/metadata file; join it with that directory to resolve it (only present when dump_cubin is enabled)

shmem_dynamic.description: Dynamic shared memory size in bytes

cluster_dim.description: Per-launch cluster dimensions [x, y, z]. Optional for compatibility with older traces.

cluster_size.description: Product of cluster_dim. Optional for compatibility with older traces.

cluster_dim_source.description: Source used to resolve cluster_dim. Optional for compatibility with older traces.

grid_launch_id.description: Actual process-global launch identifier shared by every record in this per-launch trace

sm_family.description: SM architecture family from nvbit_get_sm_family() (e.g., 90 for Hopper, 100 for Blackwell)

cpu_callstack.description: CPU call stack frames captured at kernel launch

cpu_callstack_source.description: Source of CPU call stack: pytorch (Python frames) or backtrace (C++ frames)

instructions.description: Per-opcode instruction table mapping opcode_id to instruction details (sass, binary encoding, register indices)

binary.description: Binary encoding of the instruction as hex string

regs.description: Register indices used by this instruction

uregs.description: Uniform register indices used by this instruction

instrument_modes.description: Effective enabled instrumentation modes after init_analysis() if/else precedence (e.g. proton_instr_histogram auto-adds opcode_only, deadlock_detection auto-adds reg_trace). Reflects what the trace actually contains, not what the user typed. Optional for backward compat with pre-Diff-2 traces; absence is treated as 'unknown' by contract_check (INFO exit + rerun guidance).

instrument_ipoints.description: Effective register-capture position resolved by the instrumentation configuration. reg_trace is present only when enabled. Optional for legacy traces; absence does not establish BEFORE.

instr_categories.description: Effective instruction-category filter (post init_instr_categories). null when CUTRACER_INSTR_CATEGORIES is unset -> no filter (all categories instrumented); otherwise an array of lowercase tokens matching the env-var convention. Optional for backward compat. ProxyFenceDetector and similar broad-coverage detectors require null.

trace_instr_categories.description: Targeted trace instruction-category filter, or null when all categories are captured

trace_launch_id.description: Requested process-global launch id, or null when all launches are targeted

trace_warp_mask.description: Requested CTA-local warp mask, or null when all warps are targeted

trace_pc_offsets.description: Requested SASS PC offsets, or null when all PCs are targeted

launch_attributes.description: Attributes a direct launch passed to cuLaunchKernelEx, or implied (cooperative launches). Only attributes the launch set appear, so an empty object means none; a PDL launch has programmatic_stream_serialization true. Absent on graph node launches (see captured_launch_attributes) and in traces written before it was recorded.

captured_launch_attributes.description: On a graph node launch: the attributes of the stream-captured launch that made this function's graph node, since NVBit reports no node attributes and capture turns PDL into a programmatic graph edge. Absent when the function was not captured, was captured with different attributes, or its node was built with the graph API.

function_attributes.description: Launch-relevant attributes of the function at this launch (cuFuncGetAttribute). Attributes the driver could not report are left out. On a graph node launch they are read when the graph launches, so they can differ from what the node was captured with.

preferred_shared_memory_carveout.description: Percent of the unified cache for shared memory; -1 means no preference

nonblocking_launches.description: Whether CUTracer ran with --nonblocking-launches. Without it CUTracer waits for the device before and after every direct launch, so a PDL launch cannot overlap its predecessor.

runtime_identity.description: Launch record of the runtime identity manifest (cutracer_runtime_<pid>_<nonce>.ndjson), present when runtime identity is enabled or an instrumentation plan is active. process, context, module and function are the keys of earlier records in that manifest; launch is the SHA-256 of this object without launch.

kernel_ordinal.description: Launch count of this CUBIN and entry in its context before this launch

graph_invocation.description: Graph launch invocation that contains this node launch, or null for direct launches

event.description: CUevent handle a consumer on another stream waits on

unrecognized.description: Attribute ids this build does not decode
